next.reason: Same bar: no statement may reference a file not in an open mode except OPEN and SORT/MERGE USING/GIVING (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR6; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR8 'shall be in an open mode at the time of the execution of any other permissible input-output statement'). GR6 adds 'the COMMIT and ROLLBACK statements, a DELETE FILE statement', none of which a 1985 program can contain, so no 1985-refused program becomes valid. Run-time in both.
